guidance: This is a policy-threshold reference, not borrower underwriting. Appropriate next actions may review the cited active policy but must not demand borrower financial inputs or a final lending decision. A follow-up is optional; if present it must help clarify the requested policy or its application. A generic loan-review checklist alone is not responsive.

Annual DSCR is 1.5000 from USD 180000 operating cash flow and USD 120000 annual debt service for 2025, above the 1.25 minimum. This covers DSCR only and does not approve the loan. Appropriate next actions and questions retain human review of remaining applicable policy requirements and source documents.

The signed annual debt service schedule is missing. Request the missing source before calculating DSCR or completing the review. A useful follow-up identifies or requests that missing debt-service document; a generic review checklist alone is insufficient. Do not invent a denominator or state that the missing schedule was received.

DSCR is 1.1000 against the 1.25 minimum. Appropriate next steps seek written rationale, proposed compensating factors and credit officer exception review. Follow-up questions should request the proposed rationale or factors for that review. Do not invent factors, grant an exception, waive required review or approve the loan.

The financial summary and cash-flow statement report 191100, while the signed correction reports 90000 for the same 2025 period. Preserve both sources and request reconciliation with the borrower before a numeric coverage disposition. A useful follow-up asks which signed source is authoritative or how the conflicting values will be reconciled. Do not average values, silently choose a value or claim the conflict is resolved.

This is a dated policy reference: the DSCR minimum is 1.20 under policy v1 active on 2025-01-01. No borrower financial inputs are needed to answer this reference question. Appropriate next steps may verify the cited active policy; a follow-up is optional and must stay focused on policy clarification. Do not request missing borrower inputs or a final lending decision merely to answer the threshold lookup.
